panels.title: Active Count
panels.description: Operations tracked by the report service

panels.title: Max E2E Latency
panels.description: Max end-to-end latency — red = timeout imminent (600s limit)

panels.title: E2E Timeout Count
panels.description: Hard report delivery timeouts surfaced to users

panels.title: Queued Time (ms)
panels.description: Time reports spend in queue before processing

panels.title: Batch Processing Time (ms)
panels.description: Batch lifecycle: DB poll → deserialization → handler delivery

panels.title: Report Processing Rate
panels.description: Reports processed and compressed per second

targets.expr: sum by (project) (rate(rundeck_execution_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"}[5m])) / sum by (project) (rate(rundeck_execution_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"}[5m]))

panels.title: Top 10 Failed Jobs
panels.description: Requires rundeck.metrics.execution.job.dimension.enabled=true (default off). Legend uses job_name (also tagged now, alongside the stable job_id).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (project, job_id, job_name) (rundeck_executions_total{status="failed", job_id!="", instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"}))

panels.title: Top 10 Job Duration
panels.description: Requires rundeck.metrics.execution.job.dimension.enabled=true (default off). Legend uses job_name (also tagged now, alongside the stable job_id).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (project, job_id, job_name) (rundeck_execution_duration_seconds_sum{job_id!="", instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"}) / sum by (project, job_id, job_name) (rundeck_execution_duration_seconds_count{job_id!="", instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"})) > 0

panels.title: Running Jobs
panels.description: In-memory gauge (incremented on start, decremented on finish) -- zero DB/scrape cost, unlike a live COUNT(*) query. Per-instance; sums across cluster nodes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (project, job_name) (rundeck_executions_running{job_id!="", instance=~"$instance", project=~"$project"}))

panels.title: Project Executions Total
panels.description: Raw cumulative total per project (counter value, not a rate) -- mirrors rundeck_exporter's rundeck_project_executions panel style.
